FX.name: USDTHB fair value — multi-regression
FX.what: log USDTHB regressed on DXY, gold, US 2y, USDJPY; fair value = average of 1y/2y/3y no-peek rolling regressions (ensemble); daily + weekly; views: price vs model, residual, variables, betas, significance
FX.result: Validation 2025+: price closes 20% of the gap in 10 days (t 2.1); model does not chase price (17%, n.s.); half-life ~11 days; residual close to normal (kurtosis 3.1).
FX.caveat: DXY and USDJPY overlap, so individual betas swing between windows — read the fair value, not single betas.
